dim_customer.description: Fictional customers, including gender and customer segment.

dim_product.description: Products available for purchase, including category and brand.

dim_location.grain: One row per shipping city within a state and country.
dim_location.description: Shipping locations. Multiple cities can belong to the same state. Group state totals by country and state_name.

dim_date.grain: One row per order placement date included in the dataset.
dim_date.description: Calendar attributes for order placement dates. The teaching dataset contains selected dates.

fact_order_item.grain: One row per order item, uniquely identified by order_id and line_number.
fact_order_item.description: Order item transactions in USD. All lines of an order share its customer, placement date, shipping location, and status. Line sales equal quantity times unit_price minus discount_amount.

dim_customer.gender.description: Customer gender, recorded as male, female, or not-specified.

dim_product.brand.description: Product brand. Multiple products can share a brand.

dim_location.city_name.description: Shipping city. Identify a city together with its state and country.

dim_location.state_name.description: State containing the shipping city. Group state totals by country and state_name.

dim_date.full_date.description: Order placement date. Date filters use an inclusive start and exclusive end.

fact_order_item.unit_price.description: Historical sale price per unit in USD.

fact_order_item.discount_amount.description: Total discount for the entire order line in USD. Subtract this amount once per line.

fact_order_item.order_status.description: Order status. Default sales metrics include completed orders.

net_sales.description: Completed sales after line discounts, in USD. Excludes tax, shipping, refunds, and currency conversion. Returns zero for an empty period.

completed_orders.description: Number of distinct completed orders. Count each order once even when it has multiple item lines.

units_sold.description: Total item quantity in completed orders. Returns zero for an empty period.

average_order_value.description: Completed net sales divided by distinct completed orders, rounded to two decimal places. Returns NULL when there are no completed orders.
